creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Partly answered by `a_2KIPfvt7L`: a pane whose first bridge never dials now gets a second after the deadline, and a second bridge carries `--takeover`, so an orphaned client no longer needs killing by hand.

What is still true is that the *first* bridge of a relaunch never takes over, so a window adopting its own saved panes is dark for three deadlines before it recovers.

Whether a relaunch adopting panes from its own saved state should take over immediately is a real decision with a real risk - taking a terminal from a client that is alive and simply slow is worse than waiting - and wants deciding rather than building.
title: 🔁 A first bridge after a relaunch never takes a terminal back
